career_ladder.note: SSC Junior Engineer recruits technical engineering personnel (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Quantity Surveying & Contracts) for premier central infrastructure agencies including Central Public Works Department (CPWD), Military Engineer Services (MES), Central Water Commission (CWC), Border Roads Organisation (BRO), and National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO). Engineers progress into gazetted administrative ranks through departmental quotas and DPC reviews.

exam_scheme.note: SSC Junior Engineer examination is conducted in two computer-based objective stages. Paper I consists of 200 questions (200 marks, 120 minutes) covering Reasoning (50 marks), General Awareness (50 marks), and General Engineering (100 marks), with 0.25 negative marking. Paper II is an advanced technical Computer Based Test consisting of 100 objective questions (300 marks, 120 minutes) with 1 mark deducted per wrong answer (one-third penalty). Final merit ranking is based on total aggregate score across Paper I and Paper II (500 marks).

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 6 entry basic pay (₹35,400) with 58% DA (₹20,532) and applicable HRA (27%/18%/9%). Engineers posted with Border Roads Organisation (BRO) in high altitude and remote border zones receive Special Compensatory Remote Locality Allowance and free rations.
official_perks: Departmental residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9%)
Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA in Class X/Y, ₹1,800 + DA in Class Z)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined contribution pension under NPS
Special project and border allowance for field infrastructure postings

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC Junior Engineer attracts 5-8 lakh diploma and degree engineering candidates across India. The 2024 examination notified 1,765 vacancies across CPWD, MES, CWC, and BRO. The 2023 drive filled 1,324 vacancies, while 2022 filled 2,798 posts.
